title: Nemesis
description: At the end of every other turn, gains [gold]Intangible[/gold] [blue]1[/blue].
smart_description: At the end of every other turn, gains [gold]Intangible[/gold] [blue]1[/blue].
notes: This power toggles Intangible 1 on and off on every other turn end. On odd turns it applies Intangible 1; on even turns it removes any active Intangible power.
